text: Appeal of Property Standards Order (July 18, 2024) for 117 Old Forest Hill Road

The Property Standards Committee - Toronto and East York Panel: 1. Confirmed the Property Standards Order (July 29, 2024) for 117 Old Forest Hill Road, Folder Number 24 181782 PRS 00 IV and in so doing granted an extension to November 29, 2024 to complete an inspection to ensure the work has been completed to the satisfaction of the City.
